Liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry (LC-MS/MS) analysis is performed with a Thermo Orbitrap Exploris 480 mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific, San Jose, CA) coupled with an Agilent 1290 Infinity UHPLC system (Agilent Technologies, Santa Clara, CA). Obitrap Exploris 480 (Mass spectrometer, Thermo Fisher, BRE725532, https://www.thermofisher.com/order/catalog/product/BRE725532#/BRE725532 ) 1290 Infinity UHPLC (Ultra-high performance liquid chromatography system, Agilent Technologies, 1290 Infinity UHPLC, https://www.agilent.com/en/product/liquid-chromatography/hplc-systems/analytical-hplc-systems )
The MS raw data were acquired using Thermo Scientific Xcalibur version 4.3.73 Thermo Fisher Scientific 4.3.73 Thermo Fisher Scientific

steps.title: Prepare autosampler and columns
steps.instruction: Load samples into a temperature‑controlled autosampler set at 4 °C, install the Agilent InfinityLab Poroshell 120 EC‑C18 analytical column (2.1 mm ID, 100 mm length, 1.9 µm particles, 120 Å pores, Cat.#695675‑902) and its guard column (2.1 mm ID, 5 mm length, 1.9 µm particles, 160 Å pores, Cat.#821725‑940), and set the column temperature to 60 °C.

substeps.instruction: Install analytical column (2.1 mm ID, 100 mm length, 1.9 µm particles, 120 Å pores, Cat.#695675‑902).
Install guard column (2.1 mm ID, 5 mm length, 1.9 µm particles, 160 Å pores, Cat.#821725‑940).

steps.title: Load peptides and run LC gradient
steps.instruction: Inject 20 µg of peptides onto the column, set the UHPLC flow rate to 0.4 mL min⁻¹, and run a 15‑minute gradient at the specified solvent percentages and times.

steps.title: Configure DDA acquisition settings
steps.instruction: Operate the mass spectrometer in data‑dependent mode with one survey scan followed by 10 ddMS2 events, using the parameters below.

substeps.instruction: Survey scan: Orbitrap resolution 60 K, m/z range 300–1200, AGC target 300 %, maximum ion injection time 60 ms, intensity threshold 5.0 × 10³.
ddMS2 scan: Orbitrap resolution 15 K, AGC target 100 %, maximum ion injection time 50 s.

steps.title: Convert raw data and search database
steps.instruction: Transform raw files to .mgf format and perform database searching with Mascot using the specified database.

substeps.instruction: Convert raw files to .mgf using RawConverter 1.2.01.
Search .mgf files with Mascot Server 2.3.02 against the UniProt‑downloaded protein database supplemented with heterologous protein sequences and common contaminant FASTA entries.

steps.instruction: Refine Mascot output using Scaffold and enforce false discovery rate thresholds.

steps.title: Perform weekly mass calibration
steps.instruction: Calibrate the mass spectrometer weekly to maintain mass accuracy better than 3 ppm without using an internal calibrant.

steps.title: Conduct quarterly system calibration
steps.instruction: Execute a full system calibration at least every three months, or more frequently if transmission tune fails or performance issues arise.

steps.title: Monitor system performance with QC
steps.instruction: Assess UHPLC‑Orbitrap performance by analyzing a 20 µg E.coli tryptic digest at the start, middle, and end of large sample batches.

substeps.instruction: Run full LC‑MS/MS on 20 µg E.coli digest.
Evaluate protein identifications, mass accuracy, peak shape, and peptide resolution.
